Schematic of the Ward-Beck 510 monitor amplifier: transformer-coupled input (T1 60-7), discrete transistor preamp with LDR1 remote/mute gain control, complementary MJE2801/MJE2901 output stage, and T2 80-10 mains supply with MDA942-4 bridge. Original sheet is torn along the bottom edge.
